thought.text: App is up. Now CMS (keeping stdin open with `/dev/zero` so Vite doesn't exit on EOF):

reasoning_content:
App is up. Next, let's start CMS with a pipe to keep stdin open (this avoids the "exited on EOF" problem that was happening when using just up / just serve). Wait, no — the dev server exits with code 0 on stdin EOF. When running `just serve` from my own terminal session, stdin was coming from the tool's shell. When I used nohup, stdin was being closed, which caused the EOF. Let's start each dev server with stdin kept open (e.g., from a fifo or a process that keeps stdin open).

Actually, the problem is that when stdin is closed, Vite exits. I'll use `< /dev/zero` to keep stdin open. Let's start CMS.

Actually, the dev server was working when run interactively under `just up` (app and cms became ready). The "boards exited before answering" issue — that might have been memory pressure or an EOF issue. To be safe, let's start each one with /dev/zero on stdin so they don't exit.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/fc.log
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=cms < /dev/zero' > /tmp/fc.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms serve pid $!"
